summary: First iteration smoke test: backend PDF parse + notes CRUD + photos + files fully working; frontend upload, note preview, Gmail compose, copy, edit, search and mobile layout all verified.
passed: All 4 notes have exact expected values for cliente, olo, splitter, via, n_porta_perm, porta_pte (WR 17439540, 17443542, 17414109, 17017162)
PATCH /api/notes/{id} updates cpe/ont_sfp and regenerates note_text with new CPE/ONT lines
POST /api/notes/{id}/photos accepts image, appends photo to note.photos with storage_path/content_type
GET /api/files?path=... returns 200 with correct image/png content-type and non-empty bytes
GET /api/notes?search=... filters by WR, cliente (LOPEZ), and OLO substring (FW_P)
Frontend header shows both logos (2 images), 'Open Fiber' text and 'creato e amministrato da Giuseppe Belviso' credit
PDF upload zone triggers parse; toast 'WR non numerici saltati: a17Tk00003rnRo8IAE' shown; note count increases to include all 4 WR
Expanded note card shows monospace preview with exact structure: WR:, lowercase cliente, OLO, technical line 'PTE-EST PFS X PTE Y TS TC D A MONO INT', CPE:, (ONT/SFP):
Copia nota button triggers toast containing 'copiata negli appunti'

Invia tramite Gmail opens https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm URL with all 5 recipients (impiantiufficio, impiantisnc4, abbatiscianni, naviglio, lalario), subject 'WR: 17017162', body = full composed note text
Modifica campi edit form updates the note preview live (CPE value reflected in <pre> preview)
Search input filters notes list (search '17414109' shows only that WR, hides LOPEZ)
Mobile viewport 400x800: no horizontal overflow, header and cards remain usable

failed.issue: Invia tramite Gmail button invokes window.open twice: first call with 'null' argument (likely a focus/reset artifact) followed by the correct Gmail compose URL. Functional behavior unaffected (Gmail tab still opens correctly).

action_items: Optional cleanup: remove the extra window.open('null') call in the Gmail button handler (App.js) to avoid a stray popup blocker warning.
